license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to engage in the practice of dentistry in the state, either privately or as an employee of a governmental agency or political subdivision, unless the person has a valid, unexpired license or special permit from the board.

issuing_authority.quote: There shall be in the Department of Consumer Affairs the Dental Board of California in which the administration of this chapter is vested.

name.quote: There shall be in the Department of Consumer Affairs the Dental Board of California in which the administration of this chapter is vested.

type.quote: The board shall consist of eight practicing dentists, two registered dental assistants, and five public members.

umbrella_agency.quote: There shall be in the Department of Consumer Affairs the Dental Board of California in which the administration of this chapter is vested.

age_minimum.quote: Any person over 18 years of age is eligible to take an examination before the board upon making application therefor

degree_required.value: Doctor of Dental Surgery (D.D.S.) or Doctor of Dental Medicine (D.M.D.) from an approved dental college
degree_required.quote: Furnishing satisfactory evidence of having graduated from a dental college approved by the board or by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: graduated from a dental college approved by the board or by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

required.quote: the board may grant a license to practice dentistry to an applicant who submits all of the following to the board

duration.value: one year minimum (for residency pathway under Section 1634.1)
duration.quote: having completed a clinically based advanced education program in general dentistry or an advanced education program in general practice residency that is, at minimum, one year in duration

kind.value: advanced education program in general dentistry or general practice residency
kind.quote: clinically based advanced education program in general dentistry or an advanced education program in general practice residency

exams.name: National Board Dental Examination (NBDE)
exams.notes: Written examination of the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations
exams.quote: The board shall require each applicant to successfully complete the written examination of the National Board Dental Examination of the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations.

exams.name: California Law and Ethics Examination
exams.notes: Developed and administered by the board; valid for two years
exams.quote: The board shall require each applicant to successfully complete an examination in California law and ethics developed and administered by the board.

exams.name: Western Regional Examining Board (WREB) clinical and written examination
exams.notes: One of two acceptable clinical examination options; must be within five years prior to application
exams.quote: A clinical and written examination administered by the Western Regional Examining Board within five years prior to the date of their application for a license under this section.

exams.name: American Board of Dental Examiners, Inc. (ADEX) clinical and written examination
exams.notes: Alternative to WREB; must be within five years prior to application
exams.quote: The clinical and written examination developed by the American Board of Dental Examiners, Inc., within five years prior to the date of their application for a license under this section.

interval_years.quote: Licenses issued under the provisions of this chapter, unless specifically excepted, expire at 12 midnight on the legal birth date of a licentiate of the board during the second year of a two-year term if not renewed.

required.quote: All holders of licenses under this chapter shall continue their education after receiving a license as a condition to the renewal thereof

period_years.quote: they have, during the preceding two-year period, obtained continuing education relevant to developments in the practice of dentistry and dental assisting

value: risks of addiction associated with the use of Schedule II drugs
topical_requirements.quote: The board may prescribe this mandatory coursework within the general areas of patient care, health and safety, law and ethics, and the risks of addiction associated with the use of Schedule II drugs.

available.quote: the board may grant a license to practice dentistry to an applicant who has not taken an examination before the board, if the applicant submits all of the following to the board

requirements.value: Applicant must hold an active and unrestricted license from another U.S. state/territory, have at least five years of active clinical practice or equivalent, no disciplinary history, no recent exam failures, 50 units of CE within two years, and meet other documentation requirements.
requirements.quote: Proof of an active and unrestricted license issued by another state, district, or territory of the United States to practice dentistry that is not subject to any current or pending disciplinary action such as revocation, suspension, or probation.

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person to engage in the practice of dentistry in the state, either privately or as an employee of a governmental agency or political subdivision, unless the person has a valid, unexpired license or special permit from the board.

credential_type.quote: shall be granted by the board a license to practice dentistry in the State of California.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to engage in the practice of dentistry in the state, either privately or as an employee of a governmental agency or political subdivision, unless the person has a valid, unexpired license or special permit from the board.

title_protection.quote: Assumes the degree of "doctor of dental surgery," "doctor of dental science," or "doctor of dental medicine" or appends the letters "D.D.S.," or "D.D.Sc." or "D.M.D." to their name without having had the right to assume the title conferred upon them by diploma from a recognized dental college or school legally empowered to confer the same.

scope_protection.quote: Practices dentistry or offers to practice dentistry as it is defined in this chapter, either without a license, or when the license has been revoked or suspended.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The obtaining of any fee by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing directly or indirectly any student or suspended or unlicensed dentist to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The employment directly or indirectly of any student or suspended or unlicensed dentist to practice dentistry as defined in this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting any unlicensed person to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The aiding or abetting of any unlicensed person to practice dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing any act of sexual abuse, misconduct, or relations with a patient substantially related to the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The committing of any act or acts of sexual abuse, misconduct, or relations with a patient that are substantially related to the practice of dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using any false, assumed, or fictitious name in advertising or indicating practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any false, assumed, or fictitious name, either as an individual, firm, corporation, or otherwise, or any name other than the name under which the person is licensed to practice, in advertising or in any other manner indicating that the person is practicing or will practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting commissions or rebating fees for professional services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of accepting or receiving any commission or the rebating in any form or manner of fees for professional services, radiograms, prescriptions, or other services or articles supplied to patients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making use of advertising statements tending to deceive or mislead the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The making use by the licensee or any agent of the licensee of any advertising statements of a character tending to deceive or mislead the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising professional superiority or performance of services in a superior manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The advertising of either professional superiority or the advertising of performance of professional services in a superior manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or making use of solicitors
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The employing or the making use of solicitors.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising to guarantee any dental service or to perform dental operations painlessly
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The advertising to guarantee any dental service, or to perform any dental operation painlessly.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating provisions of law regulating procurement, dispensing, or administration of dangerous drugs or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of any of the provisions of law regulating the procurement, dispensing, or administration of dangerous drugs, as defined in Chapter 9 (commencing with Section 4000) or controlled substances, as defined in Division 10 (commencing with Section 11000) of the Health and Safety Code.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Clearly excessive prescribing, administering of drugs or treatment, or use of diagnostic procedures or facilities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The clearly excessive prescribing or administering of drugs or treatment, or the clearly excessive use of diagnostic procedures, or the clearly excessive use of diagnostic or treatment facilities, as determined by the customary practice and standards of the dental profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using threats or harassment against any patient or licensee for providing evidence in disciplinary or legal action
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of threats or harassment against any patient or licensee for providing evidence in any possible or actual disciplinary action, or other legal action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of a license by another state or territory on grounds that would be the basis of discipline in California
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of a license issued, or discipline imposed, by another state or territory on grounds that would be the basis of discipline in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Altering a patient's record with intent to deceive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The alteration of a patient's record with intent to deceive.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Maintaining unsanitary or unsafe office conditions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unsanitary or unsafe office conditions, as determined by the customary practice and standards of the dental profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning a patient without written notice and before the patient has opportunity to secure another dentist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The abandonment of the patient by the licensee, without written notice to the patient that treatment is to be discontinued and before the patient has ample opportunity to secure the services of another dentist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using fraud in the procurement of any license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of fraud in the procurement of any license issued pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report patient death or removal to hospital within seven days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to report to the board in writing within seven days any of the following: (A) the death of the licensee's patient during the performance of any dental or dental hygiene procedure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly failing to follow infection control guidelines, risking transmission of bloodborne infectious diseases
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except for good cause, the knowing failure to protect patients by failing to follow infection control guidelines of the board, thereby risking transmission of bloodborne infectious diseases

disciplinary_grounds.description: Utilizing any person to perform functions of licensed dental auxiliary who does not possess a current, valid license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The utilization by a licensed dentist of any person to perform the functions of any registered dental assistant, registered dental assistant in extended functions, dental sedation assistant permitholder, orthodontic assistant permitholder, registered dental hygienist, registered dental hygienist in alternative practice, or registered dental hygienist in extended functions who, at the time of initial employment, does not possess a current, valid license or permit to perform those functions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of dentistry with an expired license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of dentistry with an expired license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining, possessing, or using controlled substances or dangerous drugs in violation of law or in a manner dangerous to the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtain or possess in violation of law, or except as directed by a licensed physician and surgeon, dentist, or podiatrist, administer to himself, any controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a dentist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any licentiate under this chapter may have his or her license revoked or suspended or be reprimanded or be placed on probation by the board for conviction of a crime substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a dentist or dental assistant licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence, gross negligence, or repeated acts of negligence in the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any licentiate may have his license revoked or suspended or be reprimanded or be placed on probation by the board for unprofessional conduct, or incompetence, or gross negligence, or repeated acts of negligence in his or her profession

definition_quote.value: Dentistry is the diagnosis or treatment, by surgery or other method, of diseases and lesions and the correction of malpositions of the human teeth, alveolar process, gums, jaws, or associated structures; and such diagnosis or treatment may include all necessary related procedures as well as the use of drugs, anesthetic agents, and physical evaluation.
definition_quote.quote: Dentistry is the diagnosis or treatment, by surgery or other method, of diseases and lesions and the correction of malpositions of the human teeth, alveolar process, gums, jaws, or associated structures; and such diagnosis or treatment may include all necessary related procedures as well as the use of drugs, anesthetic agents, and physical evaluation.

methods_authorized.quote: Dentistry is the diagnosis or treatment, by surgery or other method, of diseases and lesions and the correction of malpositions of the human teeth, alveolar process, gums, jaws, or associated structures; and such diagnosis or treatment may include all necessary related procedures as well as the use of drugs, anesthetic agents, and physical evaluation.

drug_authority.value: Dentists may use drugs and anesthetic agents as part of dental treatment; may prescribe and administer influenza and COVID-19 vaccines; subject to laws regulating dangerous drugs and controlled substances
drug_authority.quote: such diagnosis or treatment may include all necessary related procedures as well as the use of drugs, anesthetic agents, and physical evaluation

value: pediatric endorsement for general anesthesia permit
pediatric endorsement for moderate sedation permit
sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: A dentist shall possess an active dentist license or a permit under Section 1638 or 1640 issued by the board and an active general anesthesia permit in order to administer or order the administration of deep sedation or general anesthesia

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: Prior to the issuance or renewal of a permit for the use of deep sedation or general anesthesia, the board may, at its discretion, require an onsite inspection and evaluation of the licentiate and the facility, equipment, personnel, and procedures utilized by the licentiate.

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: The failure to report to the board in writing within seven days any of the following: (A) the death of the licensee's patient during the performance of any dental or dental hygiene procedure; (B) the discovery of the death of a patient whose death is related to a dental or dental hygiene procedure performed by the licensee; or (C) except for a scheduled hospitalization, the removal to a hospital or emergency center for medical treatment of any patient to whom oral conscious sedation, conscious sedation, or general anesthesia was administered

pediatric_sedation_endorsement_required.quote: A dentist shall possess a pediatric endorsement of their general anesthesia permit to administer or order the administration of deep sedation or general anesthesia to patients under seven years of age.

specialist_license_available.quote: Every person to whom a special permit is issued shall be entitled to practice in their recognized specialty or discipline at the dental college at which he or she is employed

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: Every person to whom a special permit is issued shall be entitled to practice in their recognized specialty or discipline at the dental college at which he or she is employed and its affiliated institutions as approved by the board

value: without supervision (for certain public health and educational services)
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means the supervision of dental procedures based on instructions given by a licensed dentist who is required to be physically present in the treatment facility during the performance of those procedures. "General supervision" means the supervision of dental procedures based on instructions given by a licensed dentist who is not required to be physically present in the treatment facility during the performance of those procedures.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: a registered dental hygienist in alternative practice may perform the duties authorized pursuant to subdivisions (a) and (b) of Section 1909 with documented consultation with a collaborating dentist

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: A dentist shall not concurrently supervise more than a total of five registered dental assistants in extended functions, registered dental hygienists, or registered dental hygienists in alternative practice providing services pursuant to Sections 1753.55, 1910.5, and 1926.05.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: The dental hygiene board shall license as a registered dental hygienist in alternative practice a person who demonstrates satisfactory performance on an examination in California law and ethics required by the dental hygiene board

value: medical settings that a residential facility patient has been transferred to for outpatient services
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: a registered dental hygienist in alternative practice may perform the duties authorized pursuant to subdivision (a) of Section 1907, subdivision (a) of Section 1908, and subdivisions (a) and (b) of Section 1910 in the following settings: (a) Residences of the homebound. (b) Schools. (c) Residential facilities and other institutions and medical settings that a residential facility patient has been transferred to for outpatient services. (d) Dental health professional shortage areas

mobile_dental_facility_registration_requ.quote: A mobile dental unit, or a dental practice that routinely uses portable dental units to provide treatment in nondental office locations, shall be registered and operated in accordance with regulations established by the board.

mobile_facility_followup_care_protocol_r.quote: The regulations shall require the registrant to identify a licensed dentist responsible for the mobile dental unit or portable practice, and shall include, but shall not be limited to, requirements for availability of followup and emergency care, maintenance and availability of provider and patient records, and treatment information to be provided to patients and other appropriate parties.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: A dental corporation is a corporation that is authorized to render professional services, as defined in Sections 13401 and 13401.5 of the Corporations Code, if that corporation, its shareholders, officers, directors, and employees rendering professional services who are dentists, physicians and surgeons, dental assistants, registered dental assistants, registered dental assistants in extended functions, registered dental hygienists, registered dental hygienists in extended functions, or registered dental hygienists in alternative practice are in compliance with the Moscone-Knox Professional Corporation Act

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: The construction, making, verification of shade taking, alteration or repairing of bridges, crowns, dentures, or other prosthetic appliances, or orthodontic appliances, when the casts or impressions for this work have been made or taken by a licensed dentist, but a written authorization signed by a licensed dentist shall accompany the order for the work or it shall be performed in the office of a licensed dentist under the dentist's supervision.

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: Every complete upper or lower denture fabricated by a licensed dentist, or fabricated pursuant to the dentist's work order, shall be marked with the patient's name, unless the patient objects.

teledentistry_authorized.quote: Any individual, partnership, corporation, or other entity that provides dental services through telehealth shall make available the name, telephone number, practice address, and California state license number of any dentist who will be involved in the provision of services to a patient prior to the rendering of services and when requested by a patient.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: A registered dental hygienist is authorized to perform the following procedures under direct supervision of a licensed dentist, after submitting to the dental hygiene board evidence of satisfactory completion of a course of instruction, approved by the dental hygiene board, in the procedures: (b) Administration of local anesthesia.

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: A registered dental hygienist is authorized to perform the following procedures under direct supervision of a licensed dentist, after submitting to the dental hygiene board evidence of satisfactory completion of a course of instruction, approved by the dental hygiene board, in the procedures: (c) Administration of nitrous oxide and oxygen, whether administered alone or in combination with each other.

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: A registered dental assistant in extended functions licensed on or after January 1, 2010, is authorized to perform the following additional procedures under direct supervision and pursuant to the order, control, and full professional responsibility of a licensed dentist: (9) Place, contour, finish, and adjust all direct restorations. (10) Adjust and adhere all permanent indirect restorations.

interim_therapeutic_restoration_authoriz.quote: Place protective restorations, which for this purpose are identified as interim therapeutic restorations, and defined as a direct provisional restoration placed to stabilize the tooth until a licensed dentist diagnoses the need for further definitive treatment. An interim therapeutic restoration consists of the removal of soft material from the tooth using only hand instrumentation, without the use of rotary instrumentation, and subsequent placement of an adhesive restorative material.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: Any dentist with patients who are undergoing moderate sedation to have dental office personnel directly involved with the care of those patients who are not certified in basic cardiac life support (CPR) and recertified biennially.

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: The dental hygiene board shall license as a registered dental hygienist in alternative practice a person who demonstrates satisfactory performance on an examination in California law and ethics required by the dental hygiene board
